newsitem.title: THAILAND: PRUDENTIAL TS LIFE TO RAISE CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: PRUDENTIAL TS LIFE TO RAISE CAPITAL.

text.p: Thai life insurance firm Prudential TS Life Assurance Plc said on Monday it will raise its registered capital to 927 million baht ($29.9 million) from 309 million baht by issuing 61.8 million new shares.

The new shares will be offered to existing shareholders through the rights issue at the ratio of one old share to two new shares at 10 baht each, Prudential TS Life said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The proceeds from the capital increase will be used to expand its business, the company said.
